2607.11667.title: Losing My Composure: Predicting Compositionality Over Time
2607.11667.paper_summary: We explore the phenomenon of semantic change of German and English noun compounds, with the objective of investigating and modeling gradual changes of meanings and degrees of compositionality in the past and over time. To do so, we introduce the Compositionality Trend Prediction task, which is evaluated against a novel dataset of in-context compositionality ratings sampled across several decades of diachronic corpora for 23 German and 26 English target compounds, uniquely providing per-decade ratings and corresponding trends over time. These per-decade compositionality ratings allow us to investigate empirically untested hypotheses of generalized trends in compositionality over time, such as the idea that compounds should become less compositional (less transparent) over time. Beyond our empirical observations from the diachronic compositionality annotations, we perform experiments with semantic vector representations of varying complexity, as well as several temporal granularities for training these representations on diachronic data, resulting in about 100 models of each representation type, each covering a different 1--5 decade slice of a diachronic corpus. Contrary to the decisive tendency posited in the literature, we find only a small negative trend in compositionality over time in our target compounds. In our computational experiments, we find that using models trained on narrow time slices of diachronic data (single decades, or incrementally expanding temporal windows) align better with the per-decade compositionality ratings than those trained on an entire half-century window, the latter setting being an analog for the prevalent modeling approach of training representations on an entire half of a corpus' data. Additionally, we find static representations to be competitive with contextual representations in the Compositionality Trend Prediction task.
2607.11667.paper_summary_zh: 我們探討德語和英語名詞複合詞的語義變化現象，目的是調查和建模過去及隨著時間推移的意義和組合性程度的漸變。為此，我們引入了組合性趨勢預測任務，該任務是基於一個新穎的數據集進行評估，該數據集包含了跨越幾十年的歷時語料庫中23個德語和26個英語目標複合詞的上下文組合性評分，獨特地提供了每十年的評分及其隨時間變化的趨勢。這些每十年的組合性評分使我們能夠實證性地研究未經測試的關於組合性隨時間變化的一般化趨勢的假設，例如複合詞應該隨著時間的推移變得不那麼組合性（不那麼透明）的觀點。除了我們從歷時組合性標註中獲得的實證觀察外，我們還對不同複雜度的語義向量表示進行了實驗，並在歷時數據上對這些表示進行訓練，使用了幾種時間粒度，最終產生了約100個每種類型的模型，每個模型涵蓋歷時語料庫的不同1-5十年切片。與文獻中提出的決定性趨勢相反，我們發現在我們的目標複合詞中，組合性隨時間變化只有一個小的負趨勢。在我們的計算實驗中，我們發現使用在歷時數據的狹窄時間切片（單十年或逐漸擴展的時間窗口）上訓練的模型，與每十年的組合性評分更為一致，而不是那些在整個半世紀窗口上訓練的模型，後者設置是對於在整個語料庫數據的一半上訓練表示的普遍建模方法的類比。此外，我們發現靜態表示在組合性趨勢預測任務中與上下文表示具有競爭力。
